affected_party: Organizations re-evaluating portable QIF knowledge after trust-policy or root changes
actual_problem: QIF records one policy-local trust decision but cannot preserve policy succession or replay a frozen historical decision under a later policy without rewriting history.
why_it_matters: Changed trust policy can silently alter admissibility, conceal historical reasoning, or leave stale candidates active.
why_now: v0.8.4 introduced versioned trust policy and attestation binding; rotation and replay are the next required lifecycle boundary.
